name: B10-0355/2026 (PPE) – Ongoing persecution of Christians in Nigeria, notably the Kawel village massacre
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the ongoing persecution of Christians in Nigeria, notably the Kawel village massacre
part_text:
The European Parliament condemns the killing of at least 28 Christians in Kawel village, Nigeria, on 22–23 June 2026. It asks Nigeria's government to investigate independently, prosecute those responsible, and better protect Christian and other communities under attack. It also calls for a national dialogue on the violence and its causes, and for the European Union to support victims and raise religious freedom in talks with Nigeria. The text is a statement of position and requests; it does not itself change any law.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet; it is a formal request and condemnation, not a law.
- **Who it affects:** Nigeria's government and security forces; Christian and other at-risk communities.
- **What happens next:** The text goes to the EU Council, Commission, foreign policy chief and Nigeria's government and parliament.
